summary: Ford Motor filed an 8-K on October 2, 2026, under Items 7.01 (Regulation FD), 8.01 (Other Events) and 9.01 (Exhibits), disclosing a short-term supplier issue that disrupted F-150 truck production at the end of September and reporting third-quarter 2026 U.S. sales via Exhibit 99. Management stated the expected financial impact is containable within the previously issued full-year 2026 adjusted EBIT guidance of $10.0 billion to $11.0 billion provided July 28, 2026. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, board recommendation, regulatory clock or structural mechanics are stated. This is routine operational and sales disclosure, not a special situation. Watch for further production updates or guidance revisions.
